Until this change a 16:9-only run still rendered and gated its 9:16 (never deciding, never sent).
The change (this diff): run_fresh.run_formats(run_dir) = release_formats of the EDL, unreadable -> Hold. stage_render: shoutout per sealed format; the 9:16 render, its log, postflight, loudness mux and the vertical fallback probe only when '9x16' is sealed (final9 = man9 = None otherwise); loudness.correct_finals(final16, final9=None) corrects and re-measures the 16:9 alone when final9 is None (no mux, no md5 pairing; _replace_pair of one pair). stage_gates: formats = run_formats; ("9x16" in formats) != bool(final9 and man9) -> Hold; every 9:16 measurement (run_gates, G11, G14 audio offset, G14_frame_similarity, G14c, G15, G20, G17 output, vertical_silent_fallback) only when final9; every per-format loop through each(...) = the sealed formats, in order; rows / notes / evidence / flags / limits keyed by the sealed formats; GATE_REPORT records 'formats'. run_tail's replay (start after render) passes final9 = man9 = None for a 16:9-only run. verify_pack.build: joins, credits, contact sheets and the V1 checklist for the sealed formats only; pack 'complete' / 'passed' over them (release_auth.verification_ok, unchanged, reads 'complete' and 'vision'). write_report: a gates table per format present. pulse_check_run.sh delivers when out/segment.mp4 exists (release_auth.authorise, unchanged, refuses when any SEALED format's final is missing or changed; the script's else branch, unchanged, exits 70 "NOT delivered" when no final exists).
Unchanged guards (not in the diff): release_auth.blockers per format and the inventory (release_auth.py:111); attest/authorise bind and check exactly bound(release_formats) (batch 85); run_fresh.release_verdict decides on release_formats (batch 85); stage_layout (vertical_layout.classify) still runs for every run: G4s_layout_truth and G4 per shot on the 16:9 read its plans.

MUST-FAIL mirrors: with no sealed formats the same stubs see both formats rendered and gated (G11, G14c, vertical_silent_fallback present) and the pack needs the 9:16. test_loudness ruling_93: the 16:9 alone is corrected; an off-target re-measure keeps it. On the old code (c396c3c8, a full checkout) the 6 new-behaviour tests fail and the 3 mirrors pass.
Cycle 1 (qwen27b PASS 0.95, glm PASS 0.72): three low notes, each 'no defect, fix: none' (independent format reads are reconciled by the Hold check; verify_pack.run_formats raising is a Hold because Run.stage, run_fresh.py:254 / 274-279 unchanged, turns ANY Exception into a Hold with its reason and traceback; a replay of a 16:9-only run never reads a stale 9:16).

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Ruling 93 as amended (orchestrator 2026-11-14 '21:10'): "the integrator renders and delivers that format alone".
+A run whose EDL seals formats ['16x9'] RENDERS, GATES and VERIFIES the 16:9 alone: no 9:16 shoutout, render,
+postflight, loudness mux, gate, sheet or row. Every renderer and gate is stubbed at its seam (no GPU, no network);
+the stubs record which final each one was given. Must-fail: the same run with no sealed formats renders and gates
+both (today's behaviour), and finals that do not match the sealed formats are a Hold.
+Run: cd ~/protocol_pulse && python3 -m pytest -q pipeline/test_render16only.py"""
+import contextlib

+import shutil

+import tempfile

+PIPELINE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
+sys.path.insert(0, PIPELINE)
+import run_fresh as rf  # noqa: E402
+
+ABSENT = object()
+SEG = [{"label": "hook", "type": "talking_head", "start": 0.0, "end": 1.0},
+       {"label": "shoutout", "type": "shoutout", "start": 1.0, "end": 2.0}]
+
+
+def run_dir(parent, formats=ABSENT):
+    rd = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="r16_", dir=parent)
+    for sub in ("out", "qa", "VERIFY"):
+        os.makedirs(os.path.join(rd, sub))
+    edl = {"topic": "t", "hook": {"channel": "Blockware Solutions", "selection_lock": {"text": "I sold my stocks."}},
+           "clips": []}
+    if formats is not ABSENT:
+        edl["formats"] = formats
+    for name, obj in (("edl.json", edl), ("VERTICAL_LAYOUT.json", {}), ("CLIP_CONTRACT.json", [{"clip_id": "hook"}]),
+                      ("cuts_final.json", [{"clip_id": "hook", "video_id": "AAAAAAAAAAA", "cut_in": 0.0,
+                                            "cut_out": 1.0}])):
+        json.dump(obj, open(os.path.join(rd, name), "w"))
+    return rd
+
+
+def finals(rd, fmts):
+    """The renders' outputs as the stubs (and a real render) leave them: each format's final and manifest."""
+    out = {}
+    for fmt, name in (("16x9", "segment.mp4"), ("9x16", "segment_vertical.mp4")):
+        if fmt in fmts:
+            open(os.path.join(rd, "out", name), "wb").write(fmt.encode())
+            json.dump({"segments": SEG}, open(os.path.join(rd, "qa", f"concat_manifest_{fmt}.json"), "w"))
+            out[fmt] = (os.path.join(rd, "out", name), os.path.join(rd, "qa", f"concat_manifest_{fmt}.json"))
+        else:
+            out[fmt] = (None, None)
+    return out
+
+
+def run_obj(rd):
+    run = rf.Run(rd)
+    run.machine_cuts = False
+    return run
